attributes.name: Druva - Mass Backup Failures
attributes.description: Detects a high concentration of backup failures affecting the same resource during a short interval.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a high concentration of backup failures affecting the same resource during a short interval.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL status = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE
    event_text LIKE "*backup failed*"
    OR (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*"
      AND (
        status LIKE "*fail*"
        OR status LIKE "*error*"
      )
    )

| STATS
    failure_count =
      COUNT(*),

    event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type),

    failure_states =
      VALUES(status),

    first_failure =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_failure =
      MAX(event_time),

    first_failure_type =
      FIRST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    latest_failure_type =
      LAST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    first_failure_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ),

    latest_failure_details =
      LAST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      )

  BY resource

| WHERE failure_count >= 20
